name: audit-server-ops-rendering
title: Audit server_ops k8s/Helm rendering under malformed client input
description: server_ops.py (7.6k lines) renders the fake Kubernetes/Helm API. Confirmed it never shells out, but the rendering correctness under adversarial/malformed kubectl/helm input was not audited. Fuzz/exercise the command + API parsers and confirm no unhandled exception escapes the 500 boundary or corrupts trace state.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Audit outcome: parser/renderer surface is largely graceful (shlex errors -> parse.error, unknown verbs/resources/selectors handled, malformed JSON mutation bodies tolerated). Four defect classes found and fixed inline: (1) non-string 'command' / non-list 'argv' reached shlex and escaped as 500 — now ValueError -> 400 at the parse_command boundary; (2) DELETE of nonexistent pods/deployments/generic resources returned 200 and polluted the overlay — now 404 Status with overlay untouched; (3) deployment PATCH/PUT wrote set_workload/record_event BEFORE its 404 existence check (partial state on refused mutation) — check moved first; (4) 500 bodies leaked str(exc) — now generic, detail in the structured error log. Seeded fuzz corpus lives in tests/test_server_ops_fuzz.py.
